_comment: Upstream coupling manifest. Records the langchain-ai/openwiki files this skill derives from, and their content hashes at the commit we last verified against. scripts/check-upstream.sh re-fetches and diffs these. Only these files matter — an upstream release that does not touch them cannot invalidate this skill.

coupled_files.governs: OKF field names, required-vs-optional, validation rules
coupled_files.breaks_if: a field becomes required, a new field is added, or validation tightens — validate.mjs would pass wikis the real CLI rejects

coupled_files.governs: reserved documents (index.md, log.md), okf_version placement, index generation
coupled_files.breaks_if: the reserved filename set changes or okf_version moves

coupled_files.governs: page taxonomy, page budget, diagram rules, update discipline, security prohibitions
coupled_files.breaks_if: nothing breaks — but upstream prompt improvements are worth adopting; this is the file most likely to change and least likely to be urgent

coupled_files.governs: how front matter is enforced and migrated at write time
coupled_files.breaks_if: migration behaviour changes in a way that rewrites pages this skill produced

not_coupled._comment: Our own inventions. Upstream changes cannot invalidate these.
